Replogle_K562_essential.Task: Identify genes whose CRISPRi knockdown causes a strong transcriptomic response in K562 cells in the curated essential-gene Perturb-seq panel
Replogle_K562_essential.Measurement: L2 distance between the mean gene-expression vector of perturbed cells and the mean control expression vector; hits are the top 10% by this distance after excluding CEGv2 genes

Replogle_K562_gwps.Task: Identify genes whose CRISPRi knockdown causes a strong transcriptomic response in the K562 genome-wide Perturb-seq screen
Replogle_K562_gwps.Measurement: anderson_darling_counts: the number of expressed genes significantly shifted by the perturbation, taking the maximum across a gene's targeted transcription start sites; hits are the top 10% by this count after excluding CEGv2 genes

patches: LLM.py:complete_text — all completions routed through our LLMClient at a fixed model
tools.py:parse_entries — tolerate a missing 'Solution:' header on top-up re-prompts
tools.py:agent_loop — credit an unfilled round instead of discarding it
research_assistant.py — opt-in WADDINGTON_BDA_PAIR_POOL override for the pair library
